title: Sift the Sand
subtitle: Sixteen, and you will stop counting
description: A tome-shaped node at the head of the road, and a name drawn under
Every quest in this chapter draws its name, because this is the
chapter that demonstrating names is for. It is off by default
everywhere else: a canvas of fifty names is a wall of text, and the
name is on hover for every node whether it is drawn or not.
